summary: native-frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. The setup.mjs launcher is obfuscated (rotated `_0x…` identifiers) and probes for the Bun runtime on the installer's machine; when Bun is absent it downloads the Bun release archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun, extracts the `bun` binary, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a single-line 727KB bundle protected by a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shift-based dispatcher over the `n7gIxM` dictionary) with hex-mangled identifiers; its contents are opaque and it is executed at install time via the freshly-downloaded alternate runtime, evading Node-based inspection. The package's declared purpose is a CircleCI orb aggregator for mobile CI commands, which does not require a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque bundled payload. The published npm name `native-frontend-orb` inverts the word order of the referenced upstream repository `github.com/ornikar/orb-frontend-native`, consistent with an impersonation of the real first-party Ornikar orb.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
